purpose: Worked example: Phase A (nre.corporate_events) normalizing JBSS's two real, separate 8-Ks filed 9 minutes apart on 2025-10-29 -- an earnings release and a special-dividend announcement -- into structured event records. Demonstrates the deliberate design choice to classify each filing's items independently rather than collapsing same-day filings into one event, matching how docs/m2-step2-same-day-8k-sweep-2026-09-28.json already treated these two by hand.

earnings_8k.title: Results of Operations and Financial Condition

not_a_claim: Not a claim about materiality or trading significance -- this is structural classification only, using each filing's own SEC Item number.
